channel.title: Wire — React
channel.description: React from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: a round of Graveyard Pinball
item.description: A free-to-play 3D pinball game in the browser: flip a chrome ball through a haunted graveyard table with coffin slingshots, a skull-crypt portal, mini games and a dot-matrix display. Real-time WebGPU, Three.js and TSL by Anderson Mancini. (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: explains more about how it works here
item.description: A free Halloween pinball for the browser: a 2D physics world drawn in 3D, a ball that never tunnels, and a bot that plays hundreds of balls to tune the table. (1 source: reactstatus)
